ALBUM_COVER_SUBTITLE: Turn off to show a placeholder instead, for covers you would rather not share
API_KEY_SUBTITLE: Your own Last.fm API key, which avoids the rate limit of the shared key. Leave empty to use the shared key.
CLICKABLE_LINKS_SUBTITLE: Link the track, artist and album names
CREATE_API_KEY_SUBTITLE: Optional, but avoids the rate limit of the shared key. Set any name and description and leave the rest blank.
HIDE_WITH_ACTIVITY_SUBTITLE: Hide while you have any other activity
HIDE_WITH_SPOTIFY_SUBTITLE: Hide while Spotify or another app shows what you are listening to
INSTANCE_INCOMPLETE_SUBTITLE: Set both the instance URL and the API URL, or tap here to switch back to ListenBrainz.
INSTANCE_SUBTITLE: Both the instance URL, such as https://example.org, and the API URL, such as https://api.example.org, are needed. Without them, nothing shows.
NAME_FORMAT_SERVICE_NAME: Music service name, else custom text
PROFILE_BUTTON_SUBTITLE: Add a button that links to your scrobbler profile
SCROBBLER_LOGO_SUBTITLE: Show the scrobbler logo next to the album cover
STATUS_NAME_SUBTITLE: Use '{artist}', '{album}' and '{title}' for the playing track.
USERNAME_SUBTITLE: Your username on the chosen scrobbler. Nothing shows until it is set.
